Class DifferentialMechanism

java.lang.Object
yams.core.mechanisms.SmartMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.positional.SmartPositionalMechanism
yams.core.mechanisms.positional.DifferentialMechanism
yams.commands3.mechanisms.DifferentialMechanism
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommandMechanism
public class DifferentialMechanism extends DifferentialMechanism implements CommandMechanism
Command-based extension of DifferentialMechanism that adds the Mechanism binding and Command factories.

Usage Example

DifferentialMechanismConfig config = new DifferentialMechanismConfig(leftSMC, rightSMC)
    .withStartingPosition(Degrees.of(30), Degrees.of(0))  // tilt=30°, twist=0°
    .withLength(Inches.of(14))
    .withMOI(Inches.of(14), Pounds.of(2))
    .withTelemetry("DifferentialWrist", TelemetryVerbosity.HIGH);

DifferentialMechanism wrist = new DifferentialMechanism(config);

// Command: tilt to 60° and twist to 45°.
Command scoreCommand = wrist.setPosition(Degrees.of(60), Degrees.of(45));

// Command: continuously follow a joystick (suppliers).
Command manualCommand = wrist.run(
    () -> Degrees.of(driverController.getLeftY() * 90),
    () -> Degrees.of(driverController.getRightX() * 90));

  • Constructor Details

    • DifferentialMechanism

      public DifferentialMechanism(DifferentialMechanismConfig diffConfig)
      Constructor for the Differential mechanism.
      Parameters:
      diffConfig - Lower DifferentialMechanismConfig to use.
      Throws:
      DifferentialMechanismConfigurationException - if the starting tilt or twist angle is not configured.
      DifferentialMechanismConfigurationException - if the length is not configured.
      DifferentialMechanismConfigurationException - if running in simulation and the MOI is not configured.
      DifferentialMechanismConfigurationException - if the left and right motor controllers' configs do not share the same Mechanism.
      NoSuchElementException - if the left or right SmartMotorController was never set on diffConfig.
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if either motor controller's config does not have a Mechanism set via withMechanism(Mechanism).
      Implementation Note:
      Both motor controllers' configs must be SmartMotorControllerConfigs that share the same Mechanism set via withMechanism(Mechanism).
